build.notes: In-tree build: the vorbis-tools source is extracted into obj-gcov, then ./autogen.sh and configure --disable-nls run there. The coverage build links the image's libogg and libvorbis, so the coverage scope is vorbis-tools only. The ASan+UBSan build instead builds libogg (commit 06a5e0262cdc) and libvorbis (commit e3c9861ff096) from pinned sources with the same sanitiser flags.
